subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement stay open as an active queue-policy notice now that CONTRIBUTING.md and Barnacle automation already state and enforce the 20-PR cap?
rationale: Source and release evidence show the policy is implemented, but the post-implementation rename, repin, and reopen are maintainer-intent signals that automation should not override.

options.title: Keep Pinned And Open
options.body: Leave the issue open as the visible queue-policy notice while the 20-PR cap remains active.

options.title: Retire The Notice
options.body: Close the issue as an archived announcement and rely on CONTRIBUTING.md plus automation for the policy.

options.title: Replace With New Maintainer Notice
options.body: Open or update a maintainer-owned policy notice, then close this bot-authored issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned And Open
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open as the visible queue-policy notice while the 20-PR cap remains active.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the strongest live policy signal by renaming, repinning, and reopening the notice after the docs PR had closed it.
